'''{{PAGENAME}}''' and '''Fletcher''' are male NPC wearing Survey wear found in front of Startorch Academy during the day.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Elias:''' Finally done! Lahai-Roi is way bigger than I thought... Hard to believe this is all natural.

:'''Fletcher:''' This underground cavern has existed since ancient times. Seeds from the Roya Frostlands drifted in with meltwater and ended up here by chance.

:'''Fletcher:''' You could call Lahai-Roi a natural seed vault—cold and damp enough to preserve ancient seeds and spores.
:'''Elias:''' ...And then the Reactor Drive came along and woke everything up.

:'''Fletcher:''' Exactly. Dormant until they were exposed to the light from the Exostrider's Drive. The revived plants even developed electrical veining in their leaves.

:'''Elias:''' So the Reactor Drive left its mark on the vegetation too...
{{Dialogue End}}
